option_relations.rationale: Lennox-Gastaut syndrome is a severe form of epilepsy, but the specific genetic cause points to a more precise diagnosis.
Epileptic encephalopathy, early infantile type is a broader category that includes CHD2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.
Developmental and Epileptic Encephalopathy-94 (DEE-94) caused by pathogenic CHD2 gene variant is essentially the same condition as CHD2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE).
CHD2-related neurodevelopmental disorder (CHD2 encephalopathy) is an equivalent term for CHD2-related developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE).
